item.title: American Slovak Club in Lorain kicks off Friday fish fry tradition for Lent
item.description: As Lent begins, the kitchen at the American Slovak Club, 2915 Broadway in Lorain, is in full swing. The club, founded in 1936 with its current building opening in 1956, has been serving Friday fish fry dinners for decades. item.title: Donovan Mitchell scores 32 points as Cavaliers beat Hornets, 118-113, for seventh straight victory
item.description: By STEVE REED CHARLOTTE, N.C. — Donovan Mitchell scored 13 of his 32 points in the fourth quarter and the streaking Cavaliers held off the Hornets, 118-113, on Feb. 20 for their seventh straight victory and 12th win in 13 games. Jared Allen had 25 points and 14 rebounds and James Harden added 18 points and eight assists for the Cavaliers. item.title: Monsters open homestand with 4-2 victory over Marlies
item.description: Owen Sillinger scored the go-ahead goal with 8 minutes, 25 seconds remaining in the third period, and the Monsters opened a five-game homestand with a 4-2 victory over Toronto on Feb. 20. Toronto led, 1-0, when Cleveland’s Luca Del Bel Belluz tied the game 17 seconds into the second period. It was his 14th goal of the season.
